subject.title: Feishu: benign non-zero exec exit codes render as "Exec failed" in tool-progress and interrupt streaming; no per-channel toolProgress toggle

question: Should Feishu adopt the shared nested streaming preview policy for `streaming.preview.toolProgress` and `streaming.preview.commandText`, and should `channels.feishu.streaming` remain protected from gateway config.patch?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the fix changes Feishu's public config shape and may affect the model-to-operator config mutation boundary, both of which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive product decisions.

options.title: Adopt shared Feishu preview policy
options.body: Extend Feishu to accept the shared nested streaming preview config while preserving current boolean defaults, and leave config.patch protection unchanged unless separately approved.

options.title: Only soften progress wording
options.body: Keep Feishu boolean-only and reduce scary exec failure copy, which is smaller but still leaves no way to stream answers while hiding tool-progress lines.

options.title: Allow coarse config.patch toggle
options.body: Allow gateway config.patch to change `channels.feishu.streaming`, which helps recovery but broadens an operator-controlled config path and does not provide status-only progress.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared Feishu preview policy
recommendation.body: Extend Feishu to accept the shared nested streaming preview config while preserving current boolean defaults, and leave config.patch protection unchanged unless separately approved.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the Feishu Card Kit streaming path and boolean streaming surface that this decision would extend.
